gen-gf-tektur-gf-michroma: Michroma gives every letter a wide berth, its curves leaving daylight and its ascenders staying stubby. And Tektur, drawn like pipe cleaner, does the loud talking while Michroma does the spacing out.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-mozilla-text: Distinctive from the first glyph, Tektur wears generous openings on every curve like bent pipe cleaner. But Mozilla Text, flaring its terminals and looking sturdy in lowercase, feels grounded beside that wiry energy.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-nobile: Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes, with generous openings on every curve, are the first thing you notice. But Nobile does the steadier work, leaving letter mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs and keeping caps near the lowercase height.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Expressive from the start, Tektur looks cut from strips of equal width. Its job is display attitude, while Noto Sans Adlam does the quieter work of keeping curve endings well apart.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-armenian: The body text reads approachably, with round letters opening wide and c, s and z filled out. Noto Sans Armenian would keep paragraphs easygoing, with Tektur's signage-plain lines giving the top a crisp, wiry edge.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Text feels light, with a high mean line and open-ended curves. Noto Sans Brahmi would keep a page of paragraphs moving smoothly, while Tektur's curves never thin at the shoulders.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid keeps generous space between curve ends and stems, with a high-set x-height guiding the line. And what sets the pairing apart is how Tektur reads like one thread to follow.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Wiry and wide-eyed, Tektur opens every curve generously, while Noto Sans Cherokee packs its letters into a band with short stalks above. Wire-like lines above, a wide-gapped e below: that tension is the draw.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Tektur draws its arms and legs at a constant width. Beside that, Noto Sans Coptic lets the middle zone dominate each line, with uncrowded mouths on s and c, giving the pairing its whole charm.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Tektur draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width, and Noto Sans Deseret sits beneath with open apertures and squat ascenders. Distinctive heading energy meets open, approachable legibility in the body.
